from pathlib import Path
import sys, zipfile, hashlib
root=Path.cwd()
output=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
assert not output.exists(), 'fresh external output path required'
assert root != output and root not in output.parents, 'keep generated output outside source tree'
members={'README.md':root/'src/archive_payload/README.md',
         'prior.json':root/'src/archive_payload/prior.json',
         'model.py':root/'src/c2/model.py',
         'frozen_model.py':root/'src/irt_shrink/model.py'}
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(output,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9) as archive:
    for name,path in sorted(members.items()):
        entry=zipfile.ZipInfo(name,date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0))
        entry.compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        entry.external_attr=0o644 << 16
        archive.writestr(entry,path.read_bytes())
print(hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
external_builder.usage: Run from the repository root; provide a fresh output path outside the repository as argv[1]. The stock archival builder is intentionally unchanged.
